§ 9Trivia for SSC

  • Panipat is the site of three famous battles (1526, 1556, 1761). The 2nd (1556) ended the Afghan Interregnum and revived the Mughals; the 3rd (1761) ended Maratha expansion in North.
  • Haldighati (1576): Rana Pratap's horse Chetak was killed; Rana Pratap escaped. The famous quote: "जो मुझे लाये हैं, उनका नाम राणा प्रताप है।"
  • Plassey (1757): Siraj-ud-Daulah's commander Mir Jafar betrayed him.
  • Buxar (1764): Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, Shah Alam II vs Munro (British).
  • Kalinga (261 BC): Ashoka conquered Kalinga (modern Odisha); war casualties so high that Ashoka adopted Buddhism. Rock edicts at Dhauli (Odisha) and Girnar (Gujarat) mark this.
  • Saraighat (1671): Lachit Borphukan of Ahom Kingdom fought Mir Jumla of the Mughals; Ahoms won.

§ 10Key concepts

  • Three Panipats: 1526 (Babur vs Lodi), 1556 (Akbar vs Hemu), 1761 (Abdali vs Marathas).
  • Three Tarains: 1191 (Rajputs won), 1192 (Ghori won).
  • Three Plasseys (only 1 actual battle in India): Plassey (1757), Buxar (1764) — both in Bengal.
  • Third Anglo-Maratha War: Pindari War (1817–18).
  • 1857 Revolt: Mangal Pandey (Mar 29, 1857 — Barrackpore), Rani Lakshmibai, Tantia Tope, Kunwar Singh, Begum Hazrat Mahal.

§ 112024–2025 Updates

  • India-Pakistan (May 2025): After the Pahalgam terror attack (Apr 2025) in J&K, India launched Operation Sindoor (7 May 2025) — targeted strikes on terror infrastructure in Pakistan and PoK. This was a major India-Pakistan military engagement after the 1999 Kargil War. By 7–10 May 2025, an India-Pakistan ceasefire was brokered (with US intervention). For SSC 2025–26, this may appear as a question — key facts: India didn't claim "war"; targets were terror camps; ceasefire on 10 May 2025.
  • India-China (2024–25): LAC tensions persisted through 2024; Oct 2024 patrol agreements restored some patrolling rights at Depsang and Demchok. No active hostilities.
  • Russia-Ukraine (2022–): Continues. Key dates: 24 Feb 2022 (Russia invades). For SSC, focus on the year of invasion and the parties.
  • Israel-Hamas / Gaza (Oct 2023–): Israel-Hamas war began 7 Oct 2023; continued through 2024 and into 2025. (For SSC, may not be relevant unless asked specifically.)
  • France / India / Independence Day: 14 July 2024 (Bastille Day) saw Indian PM Modi as guest of honour; 2024 was celebrated as a year of India-France strategic ties.
  • 75th anniversary of Kargil War (2024): Marked on 26 July 2024 (Kargil Vijay Diwas, 25 years in 2024 — note: 1999 + 25 = 2024). War ended 26 July 1999.
For SSC, the only "new battle" worth memorizing is Operation Sindoor (May 2025) if the exam is post-May 2025.
All other battles (Tarain, Panipat × 3, Plassey, Buxar, Kalinga, Haldighati, Saraighat, Plassey, Buxar, WWI, WWII) remain unchanged.
